newsitem.title: USA: CME July lumber futures fall ahead of expiration.
newsitem.headline: CME July lumber futures fall ahead of expiration.

text.p: CME July lumber tumbled in the last few moments before its expiry amid a late flurry of long liquidation, dealers said.
July fell $24.50 per thousand board feet to go off the board shortly after noon at $350.00. Dealers said plentiful supplies in the cash market had led to little interest in taking delivery.
They noted the cash market was quiet but the tone was weak.
"There is plenty of wood available for prompt delivery at prices people are comfortable with," one dealer said.
